def test_random_derangement():
    original = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    derangement = list(mit.random_derangement(original))
    is_derangement = all((derangement[i] != original[i] for i in range(len(original))))
    is_permutation = sorted(derangement) == sorted(original)
    return is_derangement and is_permutation
